items.title: UConn tops UMass, 35-16
items.summary: The UConn Huskies (4-3) defeated the UMass Minutemen (4-4), 35-16, to win their fourth straight over the Minutemen. Quarterback Kalieb Osborne completed 14 of 19 (73.7%) passes for 173 yards and two touchdowns. Cyncir Bowers led the way on the ground with 132 rushing yards, while Osborne added 81 yards and both scored a touchdown. […]

items.title: Huskies Roll Past UMass
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, CT – The UConn Huskies ran for 265 yards behind running back Cyncir Bowers who notched his second 100-yard game of the season on the way to a 35-16 win over the UMass Minutemen Friday night in front of 32,106 at Pratt & Whitney Stadium at Rentschler Field.

items.title: HUSKIES GO ON THE ROAD AND BEAT TEMPLE
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA, PA – The UConn Huskies went on the road and came away with a 34-20 win over the Temple Owls on Saturday afternoon in front of 21,112 at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia.

items.title: Huskies Face Temple Saturday in Philly
Huskies Suffer Overtime Heartbreak to Orange
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, Conn. — UConn football lost to Syracuse 42-41in overtime Saturday afternoon. UConn scored 27 unanswered points across four scoring drives after falling behind 34-14, but a two point conversion in overtime sealed the win for Syracuse.
